SDC Durable Solutions - Kassala:
•	Government has implemented its 12 February ultimatum for IDPs at Alk Karama2 IDPs site to vacate the site amidst chaos and vandalization of humanitarian assets;
•	IDPs from Darfur and Khordofans are being relocated to Al Karama 1. Rest of IDPs are either to return or locally integrate.
•	The AHCT engaged extensively with state authorities to advocate for voluntary return of the IDPs.

1.	UNDP Kassala team took part in the advocacy meeting on the eviction of IDPs from Al Karama site with the State Government
2.	UNDP Kassala team attended the Moment of Reflection Workshop organized by UNHCR where we delivered a presentation on Enhancing Humanitarian-Development-Peace Nexus – Opportunities for Collaboration, Coordination and Synergies.
